concepts.name: 화이트블라우스·스커트
concepts.design: 흰 셔츠 블라우스 + 차콜 무릎길이 펜슬 스커트 + 블랙 펌프스
concepts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: one fully clothed adult Yujin character sprite, a modern office outfit option. The attached image is the EDIT TARGET. Change CLOTHING AND SHOES ONLY. Keep the exact same adult woman: same platinum-white chin-length straight asymmetrical bob, hair part and fringe, dark wine-red eyes, facial outline, eyebrows, nose, naturally unpainted lips, gentle closed smile, ear shape and bare ears, skin color, mature curvy body proportions, stature. Preserve her illustration style over the entire body: fine clean anime outlines, restrained soft cel skin shadows, controlled hair highlights and illustrated fabric shading. Do not redesign the face or make her into a different character. No makeup, earrings or wristwatch.
Maintain the same head position and scale, neck attachment, FRONT upright pose, shoulder height, arms hanging loosely at sides, hand positions, adult body silhouette and full-body framing, camera and canvas 1024x1536. Keep the face/hair as close to the source pixels as possible. Preserve existing anatomically coherent hands with thumb plus four fingers and natural nails; no extra, fused or broken digits. Outfit should fit the original body naturally with sensible tailoring and room for movement, not exaggerated skin-tight or stretched. Contemporary office clothing plausible in a current city workplace. Opaque everyday fabrics, modest practical necklines, no lingerie, cleavage cutouts, micro skirts, fantasy uniform or evening party outfit. Full sprite head through shoes with safe margins.
TRUE transparent alpha background; no gray painted background, floor, aura or shadow glow. No props, bag, lanyard, logo, text, panels, watermarks or extra people. One complete sprite only. All original plum dress, buttons, belt and shoes must be replaced by the new coordinated outfit.
Outfit option 01: Opaque white long-sleeve button-front shirt blouse with a classic collar, only the very top collar button undone and a modest neckline, neat button placket, cuffs buttoned, tucked into a high-waist charcoal knee-length pencil skirt with sensible walking ease. Thin black belt with a small simple rectangular buckle, modest black closed-toe low-to-medium heel pumps. Clean professional everyday office look, no visible stockings or watch.
